Postis is an AI-fueled logistics partner for personalized shopping experiences. On a mission to make eCommerce more convenient, Postis is headquartered in Bucharest and scaling remotely and internationally. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in the world, Postis helps millions of shoppers to have an unmatchable shipping experience. 🦄
Collaboration and partnership are vital to how Postis operates. A significant portion of your responsibilities will include working closely with the Backend Team and Integrations Team members to develop features together. Engineers at Postis are also responsible for the quality of their code, so you will work with a QA counterpart to ensure all edge cases are tested. You should be proficient in using one or more of the modern JavaScript frameworks (Angular / React / Vue etc.) and have a strong understanding of building reusable components and developing them for performance.
We’re scaling quickly, recruiting teammates who share our core values, know how to get things done, and add to our very driven culture.
‍
What you will do
Build features in Angular while collaborating with designers, engineers, and product
Architect efficient and reusable front-end code that drive the Postis user experience
Manage individual project priorities, deadlines and deliverables
Identify and resolve performance and scalability issues
Build and maintain unit and integration tests
Fixing bugs fast and finding robust solutions to tackle hard problems
Follow established practices for maintaining state inside Postis
 ‍ ‍
 Skills That We Look For
3+ years working with JavaScript and one or more modern frameworks (Angular preferred)
HTML/CSS experience, including concepts like layout, specificity, cross browser compatibility, and accessibility
A strong self-starter, operationally-focused; a problem-solver
Excellent interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills
Self-driven personality: you are highly motivated to deliver top-tier solutions with minimal guidance
Learning mindset: eager to learn about and use new frameworks, languages, and APIs; admit mistakes and use failure as a learning opportunity
Adaptability & flexibility: you are able to adapt quickly to changes in business requirements and work in an agile environment
Critical judgement: you smartly separate what must be done well now, and what can be improve later; exhibit bias-to-action and avoid analysis-paralysis
Knowledge of cloud computing platforms (AWS, Microsoft Azure) is a plus
 ‍
What you will get
Good salary package & meal allowance
Stock option or attractive bonus scheme upon reaching company objectives
Rich health plan (medical, dental, vision)
Annual development budget for activities of your choosing (training, dedicated workshops, participation in industry events & conferences)
Unlimited vacation days / Holiday budget
Freedom to be yourself and choose whatever tools and equipment help you give your best
A great workplace and an awesome team to work, learn and have fun with
A meaningful job where your voice will be heard and your work will matter
The chance to give back to community and society, together with your team mates

 Why joining our team
 Postis is the first Romanian company to build a solution that manages the complex delivery operations every retail player faces. Our vision is to be a leader in the industry and become the engine that powers the growth of the entire delivery ecosystem. Just like with our partners, we believe there is value in the unique identity of everyone and even more value when they come together.
We turn the ordinary into extraordinary, by keeping innovation and customer focus at the core of our values
We do work that matters and we are fully accountable for our actions
We make integrity our mantra - we treat everyone with fairness and equality starting from our employees to our partners
We are not afraid of failure, as it provides us with an opportunity to learn and grow
We learn as we grow, and we grow as we learn. Together.
And we have fun. Every day.
 ‍
